geomorphons.role: local relative shape, dependent on search radius and flatness threshold

rules: Multiple labels may coexist at different scales.
Do not equate geometric similarity with proven formation history.
A high plain need not be steep; a cliff can border a plateau or valley.
NoData is not flat land or water.
Do not infer historical settlement suitability solely from modern modified Earth topography.
Classification does not itself implement generation.

generationCoverageExamples.need: Connected drainage, graded longitudinal profile, erosion/deposition context
Ice-flow context distinct from ordinary river erosion
Coherent regional structure and resistant/weak material contrasts
Sea level, coastal exposure and sediment context
Localized volcanic structure rather than circular shelves everywhere
Wind, sediment supply, moisture and exposed material
Soluble substrate and drainage; caves need more than a single-valued height field

measurementContract.cellSpacing: Record actual horizontal metres in both directions; arcseconds are not constant metres.
measurementContract.window: Record radius/scale for slope, relief, curvature and relative elevation.
measurementContract.validity: Preserve missing-data and water masks separately.
measurementContract.comparability: Compare generated and Earth terrain at matched horizontal resolution and comparable landform context.
measurementContract.limitations: Slope alone is neither a landform classifier nor a realism score.

generatedSurfaceShapeInspection.relationship: Uses the published ten-form count grouping with an independently written finite continuous-ground ray sampler. Not a GRASS implementation or validation against its raster output.
generatedSurfaceShapeInspection.unknownPolicy: Any non-finite sample withholds the entire scale label.
limits: Selected hill/mountain navigation targets are not an unbiased regional inventory.
No geological cause, land cover, lake or river is inferred from the label.
Subsample features can be missed; labels change with explicit observation radius, not camera LOD.
Direct radial height differences neglect planetary curvature, as local shape measurements.
Older saved manifests without shapeContext remain supported.
